categories.main_business_segments: Round One Corporation operates primarily in the indoor entertainment sector, managing multi-purpose leisure facilities that include bowling, amusement arcades, karaoke, and 'Spo-cha' (sports-themed time-based facilities). The company segments its business into Japan, the United States, and Other (including China and food services in the US). Its core operations are the management and expansion of these entertainment complexes both domestically and internationally.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages operational know-how in managing large-scale, multi-activity entertainment centers, integrating bowling, arcade games, karaoke, and sports facilities under one roof. It utilizes IT systems for operational efficiency, customer management, and service quality improvement, and actively develops and procures attractive prizes for crane games, often collaborating with creators and IP holders for exclusive content.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Round One targets a broad customer base, with a particular focus on young people and families seeking entertainment and social experiences. In Japan, the company also aims to attract seniors and inbound tourists, while in the US and China, it targets local families and youth. The company’s facilities are typically located in urban and suburban shopping centers, catering to mass-market consumers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates over 100 facilities in Japan and has aggressively expanded in the United States, with 57 locations in major shopping malls as of the reporting period. It also has a presence in China, with ongoing efforts to establish a profitable structure there, and is exploring further international expansion opportunities beyond the US and China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Round One is positioned at the downstream end of the supply chain, directly providing entertainment services to end consumers through its owned and operated facilities. It also engages in some upstream activities, such as the development and procurement of original prizes for amusement machines.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company is focused on expanding its global footprint, especially in the US, and developing new business models such as integrating Japanese food halls into US locations. It emphasizes continuous innovation in entertainment services, the development of attractive prizes, and the use of IT and DX (digital transformation) to improve operational efficiency and customer experience. Sustainability, diversity, and human resource development are also key themes.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of entertainment services (bowling, arcade games, karaoke, sports activities) and ancillary services (food and beverage, merchandise, and prize sales). Membership programs and periodic campaigns also contribute to recurring revenue streams. In the US, food service is becoming a more significant revenue component.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Round One competes with other entertainment facility operators, amusement arcades, bowling alleys, and karaoke chains, both in Japan and overseas. It differentiates itself through its large-scale, multi-activity complexes and is recognized as a leading player in the Japanese market and a rapidly growing challenger in the US market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, consolidated revenue reached 177.1 billion yen, with operating profit of 26.2 billion yen and net profit attributable to owners of the parent of 15.4 billion yen. The company has shown strong growth, with revenue increasing by 11.2% year-on-year, driven by aggressive overseas expansion, especially in the US, and steady performance in Japan.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Round One’s unique value proposition lies in its comprehensive entertainment offerings under one roof, providing a 'one-stop' destination for fun, socialization, and physical activity. The company emphasizes the appeal of its diverse entertainment options, frequent introduction of new services and exclusive prizes, and a safe, welcoming environment for all ages. Its ability to adapt Japanese entertainment culture to overseas markets, especially the US, is a key differentiator.
